# Roomi's Grillhouse

> An elephant–goldfish framework for building with Claude Code agents. A grill decides what a project must be and writes its charter and reference documents; then every ticket runs through a circuit of fresh agents: the plan, the tests, the code, an adversarial review, the integration.

Grillhouse implements the Elephant–Goldfish Model: an agent that holds the context writes, agents that hold none review, and a human settles the trade-offs. It is not affiliated with Google.

The package is published to npm as `@roomi-fields/grillhouse` (Node 22 or newer, Linux with Bubblewrap). The repository lives at https://github.com/roomi-fields/roomis-grillhouse. The skills speak French.

## Quick start

```bash
npx @roomi-fields/grillhouse init ~/dev/my-project [ticket-prefix]
cd ~/dev/my-project && claude
```

- [Overview](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/): what Grillhouse does, the intentions every rule serves, how decisions are arbitrated
- [The elephant and the goldfish](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/elephant-goldfish): the model and its correspondence in Grillhouse
- [The circuit of a ticket](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/circuit): the steps and the roles
- [The grill](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/grill): how the architecture of a project is decided
- [Getting started](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/getting-started): requirements and commands
- [Release history](https://grillhouse.roomi-fields.com/changelog): the per-version changelog
